usedFor: ActiveCampaign holds your marketing contacts, and WooCommerce runs the store. A “New Contact” in ActiveCampaign can run “Create Coupon” in WooCommerce to make a coupon for the person who just joined.

bestTemplate.name: “New Contact” in ActiveCampaign, then “Create Coupon” in WooCommerce
bestTemplate.why: A welcome offer is a common first touch, and the trigger is pushed when the contact is added. The coupon exists in the store before anyone is told about it.

watchOut: “Create Coupon” makes a new coupon on every run, so the store collects one per contact. If you want one shared code, create it once by hand.
